# Villas in Marbella

## Why Rent a Luxury Villa in Marbella?

Known for its glamorous beaches, lively atmosphere, and top-tier amenities, Marbella offers an exceptional selection of villas for those seeking a luxurious getaway. Choose from a Marbella villa with a private pool and breathtaking ocean views, or opt for a modern property with elegant designs and state-of-the-art features. For those seeking extra privacy, there are villas near world-class golf courses like the famed Valderrama or exclusive beach clubs. From beachfront luxury villas along the Golden Mile to peaceful countryside retreats in the nearby hills, these villas to rent in Marbella offer the perfect setting. Many of our luxury villas in Marbella include family-friendly and pet-friendly options, ensuring a memorable stay for all. This exceptional collection of villas provides the perfect combination of relaxation, privacy, and authentic Spanish elegance.

## About Marbella

Whether you’re golfing on a championship course, skipping through sparkling waters aboard a superyacht or shopping the high-end boutiques of Puerto Banus, you’ll soon see why this sun-kissed section of the Costa del Sol is renowned as the playground of the well heeled.

Linger over a frosty glass of wine at one of the al fresco bars that spill into the promenade, masts of megayachts jostling in the handsome harbour.

Once the sun goes down indulge in the energetic nightlife this area is famed for. Or for a gentler taste of Marbella’s pleasures, retreat to your villa just down the coast in Manilva, a charming village nestled beside this stunning sweep of coast. As the evening draws in, gather on the terrace where you’ll feast on traditional tapas prepared by your personal chef, as the sinking sun illuminates the Andalucian mountains beyond.

## Why Choose a Villa Holiday in Marbella?

Soft sandy beaches, mountain vistas, and an effortless sense of style define life in Marbella, where Andalusian heritage meets cosmopolitan living. Choosing a luxury villa in Marbella offers a refined alternative to resorts, keeping you close to the glamour of Puerto Banús and the relaxed sophistication of the Golden Mile. With sweeping mountain views and pristine beaches, these Marbella vacation rentals provide space, comfort, and the flexibility to shape each day exactly as you wish. Booking a private villa in Marbella means you can start the morning with a round of golf or a walk through Marbella’s historic Old Town, then return to the privacy and comfort of your own surroundings. Family-friendly villas offer space to gather over shared meals, poolside afternoons, and sunset cocktails on the terrace.

Located between prestigious enclaves like Sierra Blanca, Nueva Andalucía, and Marbella’s celebrated coastline, this curated collection of Marbella villas to rent includes architect-designed properties, classic private homes near the beach, and elegant fincas hidden among lush gardens. Many holiday homes in Marbella feature shaded terraces, expansive living areas, private pools, and outdoor kitchens ideal for long summer evenings. From luxury villas perfect for a special getaway to the finest Marbella villas and vacation rentals, each stay promises privacy, authenticity, and effortless Mediterranean elegance.

## Marbella Villa Rentals FAQ

### Q: What makes Marbella an ideal villa rental destination?

A: Marbella offers a unique combination of luxurious villas, stunning beaches, and a vibrant cultural scene. From relaxing days by the sea to exciting adventures, Marbella provides the perfect setting for a memorable getaway.

### Q: Why is Marbella popular for luxury villa rentals?

A: Marbella is known for its upscale resorts, high-end amenities, and stunning coastal views. Villas in our Marbella collection offer a private slice of paradise, featuring luxury touches like infinity pools, gourmet kitchens, and spacious outdoor areas.

### Q: What is the best time to visit Marbella?

A: The best time is from late spring (May-June) and early autumn (September-October), when the weather is warm but not too hot, and the crowds are fewer. Marbella is a popular summer destination, so visiting during the shoulder seasons ensures a more relaxed experience.

### Q: How do I choose the right villa in Marbella?

A: Consider what you value most, such as proximity to the beach, a quiet mountain retreat, or access to the vibrant nightlife of Puerto Banús. Marbella offers a range of options for every type of holiday.

### Q: Are there family-friendly villas in Marbella?

A: Yes, Marbella is a great destination for families. Many villas in our collection feature child-friendly amenities like secure pools, large outdoor spaces for play, and easy access to nearby family-friendly attractions.

### Q: What amenities can I expect in a Marbella villa?

A: You can expect fully-equipped kitchens, private pools, and expansive gardens. Many of our villas also offer concierge services, private chefs, and entertainment systems to ensure a luxurious stay.

### Q: Can I host an event at my Marbella villa?

A: Yes! Many of our Marbella villas have the space and facilities to host special events such as weddings, parties, or corporate retreats. With stunning views and luxurious amenities, it's a great place to create unforgettable memories.

### Q: What are the must-visit attractions near Marbella?

A: Explore the vibrant Puerto Banús, stroll through the charming old town of Marbella, visit the beautiful beaches of the Costa del Sol, or venture into the nearby mountains for hiking and scenic views.
